title: Monthly equity, index and cash-settled currency options expiration — January 2028 (the Friday of a four-session expiration week, inside the January 2028 FOMC blackout)
source: EST: RULE-DERIVED, and this entry says so rather than implying a published calendar exists. The standing convention — monthly equity, index and cash-settled currency options expire on the THIRD FRIDAY of the month — gives Friday 2028-01-21: 2028-01-01 is a Saturday, so January 2028's Fridays are the 7th, 14th, 21st and 28th. The Saturday anchor is read off TWO primaries fetched direct 2026-09-09, not assumed — nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars (HTTP 200 after 301, 109,180 bytes), whose 2028 New Year's cell reads '—*' under the footnote 'Because the holiday falls on Saturday, January 1, 2028, no New Year's Day holiday is observed', and federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/k8.htm (HTTP 200, 82,205 bytes), whose 2028 New Year's row reads 'January 1*'. VALIDATED AGAINST THE OCC'S OWN CALENDAR AND THE FAILURES ARE REPORTED: optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar, re-fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 34,871 bytes), spans 2025-01-01 -> 2027-12-31 and CONTAINS NO 2028 DATE AT ALL, stopping 12 months short of this one. Against its 36 'Monthly A.M. settled index options cease trading' rows the third-Friday rule reproduces 32, all four misses being holiday adjustments checked by name by the sibling lane that first ran this validation (Good Friday 2025-04-18; Juneteenth 2025-06-19, 2026-06-19 and observed 2027-06-18). JANUARY CANNOT CARRY SUCH AN ADJUSTMENT IN 2028: the only US market closure in the whole month is MLK on Monday 2028-01-17 (NYSE's 2028 column, same fetch — no New Year's observance, no early close), and a Monday closure cannot move a Friday expiration. Filed estimate on the extrapolation past the OCC file's horizon and on this lane's standing no-self-confirm limit for an event discovered in-sweep. Promotion requires an OCC or exchange primary published closer to the date, never a recomputation of the rule. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED by the mlk-market-closure-2028-01-17 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-09), at D+4 from that closure and inside its +/-5 corridor — a corridor that otherwise held exactly ONE tracked entry, fomc-blackout-start-2028-01-15, across every canonical event and proposal in the calendar. LOAD-BEARING FOR THE PROPOSER, which is why it is proposed rather than merely noted: the finding that distinguishes MLK 2028 from its 2027 sibling is that MLK 2028-01-17 is THIS expiration minus four — the 22/53 (41.5%) minority configuration computed 1998-2050 — so MLK deletes the MONDAY of this expiration week and the week runs four sessions (01-18, 01-19, 01-20, 01-21) rather than five. Across all 636 expiration weeks 1998-2050 only 53 (8.33%) are shortened that way, and only three closures can ever do it: Washington's Birthday (23), MLK (22), Juneteenth (8). THIS EXPIRATION ALSO SITS INSIDE THE FOMC COMMUNICATIONS BLACKOUT, which its 2027 counterpart did not: fomc-blackout-start-2028-01-15 (estimate) runs 2028-01-15 -> 2028-01-27 and contains 2028-01-21, where the January 2027 gate opened 2027-01-16, one day after that year's 2027-01-15 expiration. So the whole short week — the unpin Monday 2028-01-24 included — is a week in which no Fed official may speak. NOTHING TRADEABLE IS CLAIMED. symbols is empty, no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is expiration-keyed or calendar-keyed — trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md were re-grepped this session for holiday|mlk|closure|three-day weekend|early close|shortened week|expiration week with zero hits in both — and every frequency above is calendar arithmetic, never a market measurement. The impact tier is inherited, not measured: medium matches every other opex-* entry in this calendar. Proposed as an estimate; estimates widen caution and license no entry.
